Talent0_2Ability.name: Wild Hunt
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When dealing non-<buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>, converts <color=#F74848>12%</color> of DMG dealt into <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times equipped Polearm ATK. Equipped Cutter ATK increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color> of <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks, up to <color=#F74848>0.25</color> times equipped Polearm ATK. At the start of battle, gains <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks equal to <color=#F74848>30%</color> of maximum capacity.

When dealing non-<buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>, converts <color=#F74848>18%</color> of DMG dealt into <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks, up to <color=#F74848>7.5</color> times equipped Polearm ATK. Equipped Cutter ATK increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color> of <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks, up to <color=#F74848>0.25</color> times equipped Polearm ATK. At the start of battle, gains <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks equal to <color=#F74848>30%</color> of maximum capacity.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

102002.name: Wind Chaser
102002.describe: Uses Cutter to attack all targets within a <range type=2>2-tile diamond range</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> AoE DMG.

102003.name: Eagle Eye
102003.SpecificEffects: Enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles have their Dodge Rate reduces by <color=#F74848>8%</color>.

102004.name: Lone Wolf Dance
102004.describe:
Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> empty tile within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tile and jumps to the target tile. Cutter attack range increases by <color=#F74848>1</color> for this turn. Refills all Cutter ammo. Can continue to act with remaining movement.
This skill can only be used when legs are intact.

102005.name: Hunter's Law
102005.SpecificEffects: AP Cost for the first attack of each turn reduces by <color=#F74848>-1</color>, to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

102006.name: Crow Hunt
102006.describe: Uses Cutter to attack up to <color=#F74848>4</color> targets, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> AoE DMG. Can selects the same target repeatedly. Attacks on the same target deal <color=#F74848>40%</color> more DMG. After attacking, if any part HP is below <color=#F74848>2/3</color> of <buf ID=900167>[Crusher]</buf> threshold, that part is destroyed immediately.

102007.name: Predator Menace
102007.SpecificEffects: After destroying an enemy with active attack, all other enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles lose <color=#F74848>-1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

102008.name: Water Burial
102008.describe: Selects a target within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles. Uses Cutter to deal <color=#F74848>4x0.3</color> DMG to the target, then uses Polearm to deal <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG to the target's body (including flying targets). Can consume <color=#F74848>0%</color>/<color=#F74848>50%</color>/<color=#F74848>100%</color> of current <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks to deal <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> to the target's body equal to the amount consumed.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

102031.name: Crusher 1
102031.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking with a Polearm, if the part hit is below <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP, triggers the <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> effect, directly destroying that part after combat.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

102034.name: Crusher 2
102034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1020311>[Crusher 1]</buf> part destruction effect threshold increased to <color=#F74848>25%</color> HP.

102035.name: Crusher 3
102035.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=900167>[Crusher]</buf> to destroy a part, negates the deduction of <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> count and additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

102036.name: Crusher 4
102036.SpecificEffects: When using a Polearm to destroy parts other than the Body, inflicts <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> on the Body equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the destroyed part's Max HP.

102041.name: Nature's Hymn 1
102041.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking and breaking a part, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> Cutter ammo after combat. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

102044.name: Nature's Hymn 2
102044.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>, for each enemy within the attack range, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>25%</color>. <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> dealt by consuming <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks increase by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

102045.name: Nature's Hymn 3
102045.SpecificEffects: Movement <color=#F74848>+2</color> for first action of each turn.

102046.name: Nature's Hymn 4
102046.SpecificEffects: Polearm ATK and Cutter DMG dealt increase by <color=#F74848>25%</color>. At the end of each action, Polearm ATK increases by <color=#F74848>3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>. At the end of each action, Cutter DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>25%</color>.

hiddenSkills.name: Giant Antelope Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. Can consume <color=#F74848>0%</color>/<color=#F74848>50%</color> of current <buf ID=900166>[Feral Spirit]</buf> stacks to deal <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> to the part hit equal to the amount consumed.
